Sprawling_Mycelium_Root_Legs.description: Enveloped in a dense network of sinewy, dark mycelium threads, the Sprawling Mycelium Root Legs are a formidable yet sluggish appendage, granting immense physical resilience and the uncanny ability to burrow through the earth, while the fungal lifeforce within constantly regenerates wounds and resists the force of impacts and attacks.

Bouncing_Puffball_Legs.description: Bouncing Puffball Legs, sprouting from a thick, fleshy stem, are covered in a fine layer of iridescent spores that shimmer in the dim light. These fungal appendages, highly resilient and flexible, enable the creature to leap extraordinary distances and land softly, while releasing a cloud of poisonous spores upon impact.

Hardened_Shelf_Fungus_Stompers.description: Enveloped in thick, chitin-like plates that grow from the ground and fuse with the fungus's muscular legs, the Hardened Shelf Fungus Stompers are formidable beings, their heavy forms capable of delivering devastating blows that can both block incoming attacks and send foes sprawling with a single stomp.

Slime_Mold_Gliding_Foot.description: These supple, semi-translucent fungal appendages pulse with a viscous, gel-like substance that allows the wearer to glide effortlessly over rough terrain, while also enhancing their agility and stealth, making them nearly invisible to foes in the shadows.

Cordyceps_Insectoid_Climbing_Legs.description: Twisted and sinuous, the Cordyceps-Insectoid Climbing Legs are a grotesque amalgamation of fungal tendrils and insectile exoskeleton, granting unparalleled dexterity and agility as they adhere to any surface, enabling their host to traverse sheer cliffs and navigate treacherous environments with eerie ease.

Decaying_Rot_Wood_Trunk_Legs.description: Thick, gnarled legs sprout from the ground like ancient, decaying tree trunks, their surface slick with fungal growths that pulse with a sickly green light, granting the bearer immense strength and resilience, while instilling fear in those who witness the grotesque appendages.

Bioluminescent_Glow_Stalk_Legs.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths of the fungal realm, these translucent legs pulse with a soft, eerie glow, enhancing the wearer's magical perception and wisdom, though their presence slightly diminishes the ability to remain hidden.

Vibrant_Amanita_Stalk_Legs.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths of the fungal forest, the Vibrant Amanita Stalk Legs are a mesmerizing blend of bioluminescent hues and writhing mycelium, their toxic essence both repelling and attracting prey with an eerie grace.

Crystalline_Underdark_Fungus_Legs.description: Emerging from the shadows of the Underdark, these legs are a grotesque amalgamation of dark fungal growths and shimmering crystalline structures, granting their bearer enhanced wisdom and natural armor, as well as the eerie abilities of darkvision and spell reflection.

Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Legs.description: The Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Legs are ethereal tendrils that pulse with a ghostly luminescence, allowing the bearer to move silently and fluidly through shadowy realms, while granting a deeper understanding of the spectral world and the ability to hover above the ground, undetected by living eyes.
